verdict.rationale: BigCommerce publishes an llms.txt pointing to an official MCP server that completed a working JSON-RPC handshake, but it is a docs MCP (fern-docs-mcp-server) rather than a store-operations MCP giving agents access to catalog/orders/APIs. Missing for 10: an official MCP server exposing actual commerce/store operations (not just documentation), first-party announcement of MCP support, and independent confirmation of agent usage beyond the docs handshake.
